关于中国当局特工涉嫌绑架榆林路地区居民的备忘录。

1933年5月3日晚8时30分左右，受雇于英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）、居住于榆林路龙宗里18号的苦力丁天宝（Ting Tien Po），在经过弄堂时，看见两名来自22号的男性房客被两名身份不明的中国男子从该房屋后门带出，沿弄堂走到榆林路，并被塞进一辆等候的汽车中；随后该车及车内人员沿榆林路向东行驶，随即转入枫林路向南驶去，目击者此后便失去了目标踪迹。

目击者丁某随后将此事告知龙宗里22号的主租户、已婚妇女顾吴氏（Koo Woo Sz），但她并未对此事予以重视，也未向警方报告。

然而，由于房客次日未归，她感到惊慌，遂于5月4日下午5时45分派遣一名名为刘小毛（Liu Siau Mau）的苦力前往榆林路巡捕房报告此事。

警方立即展开调查，获悉两名被绑架男子分别为：冯中芳（Foong Tsoong Fang），约27岁，单身，苦力，宁波籍，受雇于巴克尔路531号天一印刷所（Tien Yih Printing Co.）；以及另一名身份不明的中国男子，约23岁，宁波籍，于1933年4月9日开始居住在龙宗里22号底层后间。鉴于进一步获得的信息不可靠且性质不明，有关绑架详情的电话通知已发至租界内各巡捕房、法国警察当局以及中国

Tsoong Fang (馮中芳) as mentioned in Report No.1.

It was further elicited on enquiries made in his house, that
he was usually returning home by the front door, but always admitting
his room-mate, who was very seldom seen by house occupants, via the
back door.

It is presumed by detectives that he was apparently unwilling
to disclose to anyone the identity of his friend.

At 9.a.m. 6-5-33 the undersigned visited the Special Branch,
handing over all papers found in the above man's room for detailed
examination and acquainting them with the facts of this case.

The Special Branch then, communicated with Chinese Authorities
regarding the subject, when it was revealed that four persons, the
1st man's name very closely corresponding with that of one of the
missing men, were taken into custody by Nantao Police on the evening
of the 3-5-33, as detailed on the attached report, results of
enquiries made by Supt. Tan Shao Liang (S.B).

On application being made to the S.P.S. Bureau by telephone to
see these four men by the S.M.P. detectives, the Special Branch were
informed that they were sent to Chinkiang the evening they were
arrested, following the statement of one of them regarding communis-
tic activity at that place.

They are expected back in four days when the interview requested
for will be given. Fung, missing man's father has not yet come to
Shanghai. He will be interviewed upon arrival here.

先生，

经检查失踪者的文件，获悉第一名男子的姓名正确汉字应为：
冯忠孝（Fung Tsoong Yah），别名冯忠芳（Fung Tsoong Fang），而非第1号报告中所述的冯中芳（Fung Tsoong Fang）。

进一步在其住所查询得知，他通常从前门回家，但总是让他的室友从后门进入，住户很少见到该室友。

侦探推测，他显然不愿向任何人透露其朋友的身份。

1933年5月6日上午9时，签署人前往特别处，移交在上述男子房间内发现的所有文件以供详细检查，并向他们通报本案事实。

随后，特别处就此事与中国当局联系，据透露，有四名人员，其中第一人的姓名与一名失踪者非常吻合，于1933年5月3日晚被南市警察拘留，详情见附呈报告，系谭绍良警司（特别处）查询之结果。

当上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）侦探通过电话向市公安局（S.P.S. Bureau）申请会见这四名男子时，特别处获知，根据其中一人关于在该地从事共产主义活动的供述，他们在被捕当晚已被送往镇江。

Sir,
From examination of the missing man's papers, it was learned

Fung Tsoong Yah (馮忠孝) alias Fung Tsoong Fang (馮忠芳), not Fung

It was further elicited on enquiries made in his house, that
he was usually returning home by the front door, but always admitting
his room-mate, who was very seldom seen by house occupants, via the
back door.
It is presumed by detectives that he was apparently unwilling
to disclose to anyone the identity of his friend.
At 9.a.m. 6-5-33 the undersigned visited the Special Branch,
handing over all papers found in the above men's room for detailed
examination and acquainting them with the facts of this case.
The Special Branch then, communicated with Chinese Authorities

missing men, were taken into custody by Nantao Police on the evening
of the 3-5-33, as detailed on the attached report, results of
enquiries made by Supt. Tan Shao Liang (S.B).
On application being made to the S.P.S. Bureau by telephone to
see these four men by the S.M.P. detectives, the Special Branch were
informed that they were sent to Chinkiang the evening they were
arrested, following the statement of one of them regarding communis-
tic activity at that place.
They are expected back in four days when the interview requested
for will be given. Fung, missing man's father has not yet come to
Shanghai. He will be interviewed upon arrival here.
I am, Sir,

At 5.45.p.m. on the 4-5-33 one named Liu Siau Mau (刘小毛),
B.A.T. coolie, residing 22 Loong Zung Lee, Yulin Road, reported at
station at the request of one Koo Woo Sz (顾吴氏), M/female, chief
house tenant of above address, that at about 8.25.p.m. on the
3-5-33 two occupants of the ground floor back room, were taken away
in a motor car by two unknown male Chinese. This address was at
once visited by C.D.C.114 and the undersigned when from enquiries
made the following was ascertained:
On the 9-4-33 one named Fung Tsoong Fang (冯中芳), age about
27, Ningpo, S/coolie, employed at Tien Yih Printing Co, (天一印刷所),
531 Baikal Road, rented the above described room, but removed there
together with one other, name unknown, age about 23, Ningpo, no
further description available.
Yesterday evening they were at home. At 8.30.p.m. 3-5-33 one
named Ting Tien Pao (丁天宝), B.A.T. coolie, residing 18 Loong Zung
Lee, Yulin Road, on passing along the alleyway observed Koo Woo Sz's
lodgers being led by two unknown male Chinese from their room (via
the back door) on to Yulin Road and then placing them into a
waiting motor car, which was immediately driven away in the Easterly
direction along Yulin Road, thence turning South on Fenchow Road,
after which it was lost sight of by the witness.
Ting then went to see Koo Woo Sz to enquire regarding the
occurrence.
The latter occupies the ground floor front room and being at
home at the time, was greatly surprised on hearing these news. She
did not hear anything wrong in her house. The two males' room was
carefully examined by detectives, every article appears intact, and
nothing that would provide any clue bringing the case to light.

1933年5月4日下午5时45分，一名叫刘小毛（Liu Siau Mau）的男子，系英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）苦力，居住于榆林路龙宗里22号，应上述地址的主要女房客顾吴氏（Koo Woo Sz）之请求，向警局报案称：1933年5月3日晚约8时25分，住在一楼后房的两名住户被两名身份不明的中国男子用汽车带走。刑事侦缉处第114号探员（C.D.C.114）与本人随即前往该址查访，经查询获悉如下情况：
1933年4月9日，一名叫冯中芳（Fung Tsoong Fang）的男子，年龄约27岁，宁波籍，男，苦力，受雇于贝加尔路531号天一印刷所（Tien Yih Printing Co），租下了上述房间，并与另一名身份不明、年龄约23岁、宁波籍的男子一同搬入，后者无更多体貌描述。
昨晚他们在家。1933年5月3日晚8时30分，住在榆林路龙宗里18号的英美烟草公司苦力丁天宝（Ting Tien Pao）在经过弄堂时，目睹顾吴氏的租客被两名身份不明的中国男子从房间（经后门）带出至榆林路，随后被送入一辆等候的汽车，该车随即沿榆林路向东驶去，接着在凤阳路（Fenchow Road）向南转弯，此后证人便失去了车辆的踪迹。
丁随后去见顾吴氏，询问此事。
顾吴氏住在一楼前房，当时她在家，听到这个消息后大为惊讶。她没有听到家中有任何异常声响。侦探仔细检查了两名男子的房间，所有物品似乎完好无损，没有任何能为破案提供线索的痕迹。

Two locked boxes were also found there, and if no trace of the missing men is found by to-morrow the contents will be examined by detectives.
The reason for not reporting this case to Station yesterday by Koo Woo Sz being that she was under the impression that these men had left the house on their own will being held by other men, apparently their friends, for a joke. There appears no reason to suspect that they were kidnapped, they being of a coolie class.
The men however, have not returned to-day therefore she became alarmed and had the matter reported to Station as above.
It was further learned by detectives that today Fung did not turn up for work at his place of employment.
Diligent enquiries were made by detectives round Koo Woo Sz's house and the spot on Yulin Road, where the motor car was seen by Ting, but neither other witnesses could be located, nor information of value to Police, obtained.
Ting states that it was a large touring car, black painted, he did not notice the number, or whether it was private or hire car.
Koo Woo Sz states that her lodgers appeared to be quite respectable men and were frequently visited by friends.
A telephone message has been circulated asking all stations as well as Chinese Authorities to communicate at once with Yulin Road, if any Police had arrested two male Chinese at the aforementioned address at the time stated above, and further asking to have enquiries made in public garages to ascertain if any car was taken to Yulin Road near Loong Zung Lee last evening and carried two more men away.
The undersigned would note that no weapons of any kind were observed by Ting in possession of the men escorting, and no alarm w

现场还发现了两个上锁的箱子，如果到明天仍找不到失踪者的踪迹，侦探将检查箱内物品。
顾吴氏昨天未向警局报告此案的原因是，她以为这些人是被其他人（显然是他们的朋友）开玩笑似地强行带离住所的。似乎没有理由怀疑他们遭到绑架，因为他们属于苦力阶层。
然而，这两人今天并未返回，因此她感到惊慌，并按上述情况向警局报了案。
侦探进一步获悉，冯中芳今天未去工作单位上班。
侦探在顾吴氏住处周围以及丁在榆林路看到汽车的地点进行了详尽的调查，但既未找到其他证人，也未获得对警方有价值的信息。
丁称那是一辆大型黑色旅游轿车，他没有注意车牌号码，也未留意是私家车还是出租车。
顾吴氏称，她的租客看起来是很正派的人，经常有朋友来访。
已发出电话通知，要求各警局及中国当局，若在上述时间于上述地址逮捕了两名中国男子，请立即与榆林路方面联系；并进一步要求在公共车库进行调查，以查明昨晚是否有车辆被开往龙宗里附近的榆林路并载走了另外两名男子。
本人谨注，丁称在事发时未观察到护送人员持有任何武器，且冯或其室友在当时也未发出警报
